digest.en: US attempts to open the Strait of Hormuz are testing a fragile Iran war ceasefire. Ukraine struck Russia's Primorsk oil hub in a massive drone swarm. Producers are staying disciplined as geopolitics boost US LNG and pipeline demand.
digest.hi: भारत ने फुजैरा में ईरानी हमले की कड़ी निंदा की, कहा कि कूटनीति और बातचीत से ही मुद्दों का समाधान हो सकता है। प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी की मई में चार यूरोपीय देशों की महत्वपूर्ण यात्रा से पहले यह बयान आया है। ईरान पर कार्रवाई को लेकर ट्रंप ने कहा कि उनका मिनी वॉर सफल रहा।

articles.title: U.S. attempt to open Strait of Hormuz tests fragile Iran war ceasefire
articles.summary: US forces attempted to open the Strait of Hormuz, testing a fragile Iran war ceasefire. The move came despite a reported ceasefire, with the UAE saying Iran fired missiles and drones at it, though the ceasefire seemed to be holding.

articles.title: Ukraine strikes Russia’s Primorsk oil hub and ‘shadow fleet’ in massive drone swarm
articles.summary: Ukraine launched a massive drone swarm at Russia's Primorsk oil hub and its 'shadow fleet'. The attack targeted a key oil export facility and a fleet of Russian ships. Ukraine strikes Russia’s Primorsk oil hub and ‘shadow fleet’ in massive drone swarm.

articles.title: Producers Stay Disciplined as Geopolitics Boost U.S. LNG, Pipeline Demand
articles.summary: US LNG and pipeline demand rose due to geopolitics, producers staying disciplined. Kinder Morgan's Sanders attributed the increase to geopolitical tensions and producers' restraint in production. Kinder Morgan’s Sanders: Producers Stay Disciplined as Geopolitics Boost U. S.

articles.title: Attacks in Strait of Hormuz, Gulf region imperil fragile U.S.-Iran ceasefire
articles.summary: Attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and Gulf region threatened a fragile US-Iran ceasefire. The incidents raised concerns about the ceasefire's stability, with the UAE reporting Iranian missile and drone strikes.

articles.title: Prime Minister Ilie Bolojan faces confidence vote in parliament after largest party, PSD, quit his
articles.summary: Romania's Prime Minister Ilie Bolojan faces a confidence vote after the largest party, PSD, quit his coalition. The Social Democrats left due to unpopular austerity measures, and lawmakers will decide whether to oust the PM.

articles.title: SMRT bus catches fire near Woodgrove Primary School in Woodlands; no injuries reported
articles.summary: A SMRT bus caught fire near Woodgrove Primary School in Woodlands at 1:40pm. The Singapore Civil Defence Force extinguished the fire using a water jet and hosereel, with no injuries reported.

articles.title: US Dollar Firms on Geopolitical Risks as FX Markets Weaken and Oil Caps USD Gains
articles.summary: The US dollar strengthened due to geopolitical risks. Gains were capped by a weaker foreign exchange market and oil prices. US Dollar Firms on Geopolitical Risks as FX Markets Weaken and Oil Caps USD Gains Forex Factory.

articles.title: Maid accused of stealing employer's clothes claims they were thrown away
articles.summary: A maid accused of stealing her employer's clothes claimed they were thrown away. The judge set aside her conviction, citing a lack of intention to steal. The judge set aside her conviction since her claim that the clothes had been thrown away showed that she had no intention to steal.

articles.title: Seven cases confirmed or suspected on stranded cruise ship
articles.summary: Seven cases, including three deaths, were confirmed or suspected on a stranded cruise ship. One person was critically ill and three had mild symptoms. The seven cases included ‌three people who had died, one who was critically ill and three with mild symptoms, the WHO said in a statement ‌late on May 4.

articles.title: Russian air attacks kill five at Ukraine’s Naftogaz gas facilities
articles.summary: Russian air attacks killed five people at Ukraine's Naftogaz gas facilities. Three workers and two emergency service rescuers died, with 37 others wounded. Three workers and two emergency service rescuers ​killed and 37 others wounded, Naftogaz CEO Serhiy ​Koretskyi says.

articles.title: 9 Killed In Explosion At Coal Mine In Colombia Due To Gas Buildup
articles.summary: A coal mine explosion in Colombia killed 9 people due to gas buildup. Mining accidents in Colombia often occur because of poor ventilation. Mining accidents in Colombia usually occur due to poor ventilation.

articles.title: Ex-Model Accuses French Scout Of Grooming Her For Jeffrey Epstein
articles.summary: A former model accused a French scout of grooming her for Jeffrey Epstein. Epstein allegedly took her passport and held her hostage. Epstein allegedly took Juliette's passport and held her 'hostage'.

articles.title: Attacks in Gulf Threaten to Reignite Conflict
articles.summary: U. S. warships shot down missiles and drones aimed at ships in the Strait of Hormuz. Authorities in the United Arab Emirates blamed Iran for a drone attack. Attacks in Gulf Threaten to Reignite Conflict.

articles.title: Fireworks Factory Explosion in China Kills at Least 26
articles.summary: A fireworks factory explosion in China killed at least 26 people. Dozens more were injured in the blast. Dozens more were injured in the explosion, which appeared to be one of the country’s deadliest in recent years.

articles.title: Hong Kong Q1 GDP expands at strongest pace in nearly five years
articles.summary: Hong Kong's GDP expanded at its strongest pace in nearly five years in Q1. The growth rate was not specified. Hong Kong Q1 GDP expands at strongest pace in nearly five years.

articles.title: Indonesia's first-quarter economic growth is fastest in over three years
articles.summary: Indonesia's economy grew 5.3% year-over-year in the first quarter, the fastest pace in over three years. This growth outpaced a 5.1% forecast and marked a significant improvement from the previous quarter.

articles.title: India’s largest stock exchange set for landmark IPO after years of delays amid market uncertainty
articles.summary: India's National Stock Exchange is planning a landmark IPO after years of delays due to regulatory hurdles. The exchange has faced investigations into governance lapses and preferential market access. The long-delayed listing comes after nearly a decade of regulatory hurdles, including investigations into alleged governance lapses and preferential market access.

articles.title: How the US-Iran war disrupted a global energy lifeline
articles.summary: The US-Iran war disrupted the Strait of Hormuz, a critical global energy route. The waterway connects the Persian Gulf to the Gulf of Oman and carries a significant portion of the world's oil supply.

articles.title: What Iran is saying about attack on UAE
articles.summary: Iran has commented on the attack on the UAE, though specific details of their statements are not provided. The incident strained relations between the two countries. What Iran is saying about attack on UAE.

articles.title: Does Quarantine On A Cruise Ship Minimise Disease Spread?
articles.summary: Quarantine on a cruise ship can help reduce the spread of disease, according to a study on hantavirus. This measure is considered effective in minimizing the transmission of infectious diseases.

articles.title: Malawi fuel crisis deepens as oil shortages spread
articles.summary: Malawi's fuel crisis worsens with widespread oil shortages. The government has sold gold reserves to buy fuel, incurring significant costs. The fuel crisis has hit Malawi probably harder than anywhere else in Africa.
